$comment: Production Content-Security-Policy for the GoalCert subdomain (H-05). vite.config.js writes it into dist/index.html as a <meta> tag at build time, replacing %API_ORIGIN% with the origin of VITE_API_URL (or dropping it when the API is on the same origin) and %EXTRA_CONNECT% with VITE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC. CloudFront must also send it as a response header (README: Deploying), because frame-ancestors only works as a header.
